channel.title: Net Sense
channel.description: Studio network monitoring for Mac, by Nathaniel Labs.

item.description:
# Net Sense 1.0.8
Security and reliability release for the native Mac app.
- Packages its own standalone Apple-silicon engine; receiving Macs no longer need Python, Xcode or Homebrew. - Keeps the controller login in this Mac's Keychain and preserves the app's browser session across launches. - Restricts the engine and every private or mutating action to this Mac only, with loopback, host, origin and JSON request checks. - Recovers from the WebKit GPU crash seen on the studio Mac by switching to a stable compatibility renderer. - Separates live traffic from tested line capacity so current usage is never presented as an internet speed test. - Reads the live ER7212PC controller using field mappings re-verified against a fresh probe: ACT on WAN3, JIO on WAN/LAN4, four EAP655-Wall access points. - Makes unverified Shield and guest-authentication features visibly unavailable instead of pretending they changed the network. - Signed with Jason's Developer ID and accepted and stapled by Apple's notarization service.
